DAWN.clocksChanged: The clock changed while confirmation was open. Review it before deleting.

DAWN.koTensionEligibility: Tension increase eligibility was not confirmed.
DAWN.koTensionUncertain: The update could not be confirmed. Check Tension and the record before retrying.
DAWN.duelExperimentalHint: For testing only: do not use in a real combat before Foundry and recovery testing.
DAWN.duelStartHint: Target one adjacent NPC. The current hero spends Influence and both tokens move to the reserve area.
DAWN.duelPublicStake: The stake and participants are known to all players
DAWN.duelSelectTarget: Target exactly one NPC in Foundry during the hero's turn.
DAWN.duelDeparted: Participants are off the board. Use this tool to resolve the Duel when appropriate.
DAWN.duelDepartureHint: Confirm moving the tokens to the reserve area. Their state is preserved.

DAWN.duelOutcomeSaved: Outcome saved. Continue using the Duel tool.
DAWN.duelConsequencesHint: Apply the consequences and stake manually, then confirm they are complete.
DAWN.duelReturnHint: Choose edge cells on the original board, numbered 1 through 7. Token size and occupancy are checked.
DAWN.duelTeleportManual: This is an in-game Teleport. Resolve terrain and reactions manually.
DAWN.duelReturned: Participants returned; the Duel is complete.
DAWN.duelPermission: Only the designated Narrator controls Duels.
DAWN.duelParticipants: The participants or their positions changed; check the tokens and combat.
DAWN.duelPrivacy: For this experimental Duel, the participants and scene must be visible to all players; fog and vision must be disabled.
DAWN.duelGeometryUnknown: The geometry or prepared board could not be verified.
DAWN.duelParticipantAccount: Configure one player's Influence account and link the hero in the party sheet.
DAWN.duelInfluence: Not enough Influence for the Duel.
DAWN.duelParticipantBusy: A participant is already in a Duel.
DAWN.duelWriteUncertain: The Duel and its cost could not be confirmed. Check the account and record before retrying.
DAWN.duelDepartureUnavailable: Removing participants is not available now.
DAWN.duelDepartureUncertain: Departure could not be confirmed. Check both tokens and the Duel record; there is no automatic retry.
DAWN.duelChanged: The Duel record changed. Reopen the tool.
DAWN.duelOutcomeInvalid: Check the results, decision and timing confirmation; resolve a tie manually.
DAWN.duelForcedTake: After losing the reroll the initiator must Take It.
DAWN.duelOutcomeUncertain: The outcome or Influence refund was not confirmed. Check the record and balance before retrying.
DAWN.duelReturnInvalid: Check the free edge cells, token sizes and Teleport support.
DAWN.duelReturnOccupied: A selected cell is occupied or the tokens overlap.
DAWN.duelReturnUncertain: Return could not be confirmed. Check both tokens and the Duel record; there is no automatic retry.
DAWN.duelRecoveryManual: An unfinished step requires manual reconciliation of tokens, resources and the record. Do not blindly retry it.
DAWN.duelReconcileHint: The step is confirmed only if both tokens are already in the expected state. Movement and costs are never repeated. A partial transfer needs manual review.
DAWN.duelReconciled: Token state confirmed; the Duel record was updated.
DAWN.duelRecoveryUncertain: The reconciliation write was not confirmed. Check the Duel state before retrying.
DAWN.duelFailure: The Duel step failed. Check its state before retrying.
DAWN.npcActionEffectsManual: Resolve the roll and effects separately.
DAWN.npcActionPermission: Only the designated Narrator can spend AP for this action.
DAWN.npcActionInvalid: The NPC action or turn could not be identified.
DAWN.npcActionAlreadyUsed: This action has already been used this turn.
DAWN.npcActionWriteUncertain: AP update could not be confirmed. Check AP and action history before retrying.
DAWN.attackRecoveryManual: No confirmed operation receipt was found. Check Focus, defense, and health manually; the operation will not be repeated automatically.
DAWN.attackRecoveryUnavailable: This attack is not in a state that can be reconciled here.
DAWN.reactionSkipGMHint: Confirm the reaction is skipped or was resolved manually. You can then confirm damage.
DAWN.reactionAutoSentUnconfirmed: Core reaction skipped due to insufficient Focus; response sent without confirmation. Discuss special reactions with the Narrator.
DAWN.reactionExperimentalHint: Testing only: restart the world after installation; do not use with hidden targets.
DAWN.reactionPrepareHint: Use Foundry targeting to select one target. Enter final damage before defenses and verify the roll is an attack.
DAWN.reactionSuggestedDamage: The base calculation from the card is prefilled. Confirm the hit and add conditional bonuses and effects before confirming.
DAWN.attackHeightReminder: The attacker and target are at different heights: apply the height Advantage or Disadvantage manually.
DAWN.reactionSelectTarget: Select exactly one hero target on the current scene.
DAWN.reactionConfirmMovementHint: Confirm that movement or agreed manual resolution is complete.
DAWN.reactionConfirmDamageHint: Apply the amount after defenses? Resolve special outcomes manually.
DAWN.reactionStandardWound: Apply a standard Wound if needed
DAWN.reactionStandardWoundHint: If the hero has fewer than two Wounds, reaching zero Health adds a Wound and restores Health. Resolve Influence and special rules manually; damage is not applied if a Knockout is possible.
DAWN.reactionFailed: The reaction could not be completed. Check its state before retrying.
DAWN.reactionOwnerOffline: No active owner is online; resolve the reaction manually.
DAWN.attackJournalUnavailable: Local journal or safe locking is unavailable.
DAWN.attackPrivacy: This target or roll is not eligible for experimental reactions; resolve manually.
DAWN.attackPermission: Only the designated Narrator can manage reactions.
DAWN.attackChanged: The data changed. Check the attack and target.
DAWN.attackBusy: The attack is already being processed.
DAWN.reactionBusy: Another reaction for this hero is being processed.
DAWN.reactionPrompt: An attack has been declared against this character. Choose a reaction or resolve it manually with the Narrator.
DAWN.reactionLowFocus: Basic Block and Dodge require 2 Focus.
DAWN.reactionMoveManual: Resolve reaction movement and special conditions with the Narrator.
DAWN.reactionSpecialManual: Resolve character-specific reactions and cancelled attacks manually.
DAWN.reactionSentUnconfirmed: Response sent to the Narrator; wait for confirmation.
DAWN.reactionExecutorOffline: The designated Narrator is offline. No response was sent.
DAWN.heroAttackRollHint: Attack roll; track AP and effects separately.

DAWN.npcDamagePreviewHint: If the attack hits: before defenses and special conditions; damage has not been applied.

DAWN.boardBrushHint: Click a cell on the prepared board. Shift-click removes the selected marker; Esc cancels the tool.
DAWN.boardBrushMoveHint: Click a destination for the selected fodder zone. Esc cancels.
DAWN.boardBrushOutside: Choose a cell on either 7 × 7 board.
DAWN.clocksExecutor: Only the designated GM can edit clocks.
DAWN.clocksSaveError: Could not confirm the clock was saved. Check its state before retrying.
DAWN.clocksInvalid: Enter a name and a number of segments from 2 to 12.
DAWN.sceneMarkerHint: Select a board, cells, and marker type. While the designated GM is online, low and high ground change a one-cell token's elevation at the movement destination. Resolve intermediate paths and other terrain rules manually.
DAWN.sceneMarkerPermission: This tool is available to the GM.
DAWN.sceneMarkerUncertain: Marker changes could not be confirmed. Check the board before retrying.
DAWN.sceneHeightRules: Entering higher ground stops movement and reduces Speed to 0 until the end of the turn. Apply Advantage when attacking down or Disadvantage when attacking up: half the attacker's Tier, rounded up. The Narrator resolves special transitions and exceptions.
DAWN.sceneHeightManual: Resolve elevation manually for large tokens or ambiguous cells.
DAWN.sceneHeightUncertain: Token elevation could not be confirmed; check it manually.
DAWN.sceneHeightHidden: A hidden token changed elevation. Check high-ground rules.
DAWN.fodderSideHint: The side sets token disposition and reminders. Player control permissions are configured separately.
DAWN.fodderMoveHint: Select one destination on the same board, at most two spaces away. The Narrator decides when movement is allowed and resolves the path and obstacles.
DAWN.fodderMoveSelect: Select one living one-cell Fodder Zone on the main or secondary board.
DAWN.fodderMoveChanged: The zone or its position changed. Select it again.
DAWN.fodderMoveDestination: Select one cell on the same board.
DAWN.fodderMoveDistance: A zone can move at most two spaces.
DAWN.fodderMoveBusy: Wait for the token's previous movement to finish.
DAWN.fodderMoveUncertain: Movement could not be confirmed. Check the zone's position before retrying.
DAWN.heroRollSourcesChanged: A selected Attribute or feature changed. Open the roll dialog again.
DAWN.fodderControllerReserveInvalid: Invalid token coordinates or dimensions. Check the reserve.
DAWN.fodderControllerInvalid: The template or permissions are unavailable, or the profile is unsupported.
DAWN.fodderControllerCreated: Controller created in reserve. Add it to combat and place 4 + Tier Fodder Zones; resolve actions and Knockout manually.
DAWN.fodderControllerUnsupportedBoard: Placing the controller requires the prepared DAWN board.
DAWN.fodderControllerUnconfirmed: Placement was not confirmed. Check the scene and Actors before retrying: documents may have been created.
DAWN.fodderControllerNotTarget: The service controller is not a game target; choose a Fodder Zone.

DAWN.fodderTemplateMissing: First create a Fodder Zone template using the DAWN button.
DAWN.fodderTemplateInvalid: The Fodder Zone template changed or is unavailable. Check Actors and choose again.

DAWN.fodderDuplicate: Multiple Fodder templates were found. Check the Actors directory.
DAWN.fodderUnconfirmed: Template creation was not confirmed. Check Actors before retrying.

DAWN.battleReconcileWarning: Review the current combatant, round, order, AP, Focus, Tension, and effects. A new turn ID and timeline will be created; previously automated durations become manual. Resources will not be granted again.
DAWN.battleTurnBusy: Another turn operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish and try again.
DAWN.battleTurnMismatch: The current turn does not match the DAWN turn record. The Narrator must review combat and reconcile the turn.

DAWN.name: Name
DAWN.emptyTechniques: Choose Techniques from the library or drag an Item from a compendium.
DAWN.derivedExplanation: Health = 10 + Body + 2×Tier. Recalculation does not restore spent resources.
DAWN.builderIntro: Set Attributes, add Skills/Ability/Bonds, choose an Outlook, two Boons and five Technique levels. The sheet and builder use the same data. This initial builder validates Tier 1; higher-Tier advancement is still being implemented.
DAWN.validationPassed: The starting build meets the rules.
DAWN.alreadyReady: Character is already ready. Resources are not restored again.
DAWN.rollPaused: Technical limit reached. The partial result is saved, not complete.
DAWN.quickNote: Quick compresses each selected source separately. No Crits. For multiple sources use the character features individually; unusual modifiers require an agreed final pool.
DAWN.quickExplicit: This Quick form requires zero Advantage/Disadvantage; use an explicit agreed source instead.
DAWN.noPermission: You do not own this document.
DAWN.heroOnly: This action is for a player character.
DAWN.executorHint: One assigned GM writes mechanical consequences. An offline executor is not replaced automatically.
DAWN.battleExecutorHint: Combat controls are available to the assigned GM. Change the executor in the DAWN game settings if needed.
DAWN.executorOffline: The assigned GM is unavailable or no longer a GM. The action has not been spent.
DAWN.executorOnly: Only the assigned GM can execute this operation.
DAWN.geometryHint: Reserved: the system does not yet automatically check distances, reach, or movement costs.
DAWN.recovery: Operation stopped; inspect confirmed stages before continuing
DAWN.notYourTurn: Open the current combatant's sheet during its Turn.
DAWN.onceRound: This non-Swift Basic Action has already been used this Round.
DAWN.needTokens: Place character tokens on the Scene first.
DAWN.catalogIntro: Open the library from a character sheet to add features; enemies can be created by the Narrator.
DAWN.previousLevel: Acquire the previous Technique level first.
DAWN.threeArchetypes: A standard build allows up to three Archetypes.
DAWN.fiveLevels: The starting budget is five Technique levels.
DAWN.advancementManual: Advancement of a ready character: disable standard build for an agreed change.
DAWN.specialDeployment: This profile needs special Fodder deployment; the imported Actor is a reference, not a completed deployment.
DAWN.manualNotice: Complex features currently use text, editable notes and manual state changes. Their full automatic consequences are not implemented.
DAWN.partyEmpty: Personal accounts have not yet been configured.

DAWN.duelTimelineChanged: The combat timeline changed during a Duel. Reconcile its participants and record manually before continuing.
DAWN.duelResolveNow: No other allies or enemies remain on the board: resolve the Duel first.
DAWN.duelResolveTurn: A duelist's turn is about to begin: resolve the Duel and return its participants first.
DAWN.partyAccountHint: Select a player and their owned hero. Enter the current balance; existing accounts will not be changed.
DAWN.partyAccountPermission: Only the designated Narrator can add accounts.
DAWN.partyAccountInvalid: Choose a player and their owned hero, and enter a non-negative whole Influence value.
DAWN.partyAccountExists: This player or hero already has an account. Check it instead of creating a duplicate.
DAWN.partyAccountUncertain: Account creation could not be confirmed. Check the list before retrying; the identifier is in the notification.
DAWN.welcomeText: Characters, enemies, Technique levels and XD6. The first working development build.

validation.tierCreation: This builder currently finalizes Tier 1 only.

validation.eightRanks: Spend exactly eight starting Character Ranks.
validation.oneAbility: A character may have at most one Ability.
validation.levelOrder: Technique levels must be sequential and unique.

DAWN.oneSourceEach: Select at most one Skill, Ability and Bond.
DAWN.emptySources: Add Skills, an Ability and Bonds to use them in rolls.
DAWN.fodderZeroHealth: The Fodder Zone is knocked out; move it to discard. Tension does not change automatically.
DAWN.npcActionChanged: The NPC action or Tier changed. Open the action roll again.
DAWN.npcActionManualHint: AP costs for ordinary actions and Swift Stride can be recorded separately. Resolve rolls, damage, and effects separately. An NPC cannot repeat an ordinary action in one Turn.
DAWN.npcAceManualHint: Ace: 2 AP, once per Scene at the stated Tension; its use ends the Turn. Summoned NPCs cannot use Aces. The Narrator currently tracks these conditions and the AP cost manually.
DAWN.npcPoolRequired: Enter the number of base dice from the action description.
DAWN.npcPoolHint: Check the action requirements; costs, damage, and effects are handled manually.
DAWN.npcFormulaHint: Value = base + increment × Tier. Leave the fixed value empty to use the formula; 0 explicitly sets zero. Recalculation does not restore Health or Evasion.
DAWN.presetTierHint: Ready book profile. Choose a Tier; statistics are calculated automatically.
DAWN.quickSourceHint: Quick: each source grants 1 die at 1–2 or 2 dice at 3+. No Crits.
DAWN.quickDisadvantageHint: The book does not specify Disadvantage in Quick. Agree a pool adjustment at the table and enter it here.
DAWN.tableDefaultsHint: Starting settings for new rolls. Each participant can adjust their roll; agree who sets modifiers at the table.
DAWN.chooseBookEnemy: Choose a ready enemy from the book.
DAWN.buildOnSheetHint: Edit attributes, Skills, Ability, Bonds and Techniques on the main sheet. Check starting budgets and choose an Outlook here.
DAWN.unlockToChange: Unlock the sheet at the top left to change the build.
DAWN.advancementHint: Set the Tier after an agreed advancement and record the chosen improvements on the sheet. Current resources are preserved.
DAWN.advancementRules:
A new Tier normally requires 15 Experience; the Narrator may set the party’s pace.
Benefits: +1 to two different Attributes, 2 Skill/Ability Ranks, 1 Boon and 2 Technique levels (or +1 to the highest Attribute). Ranks, Boons and Techniques may be saved for Awakening.
DAWN.freeContextHint: Choose an Attribute and one relevant Skill, Ability and Bond. Agree their relevance with the Narrator.
DAWN.combatContextHint: Combat has its own pool: unstructured Skills, Ability and Bonds are not added. Set modifiers in the roll window.
DAWN.manualStatisticsHint: An empty field uses the formula. A specified value overrides the base before effects; 0 means zero.
DAWN.tokenArtHint: Choose artwork and token image in Overview. The token image is used when dragging the character onto a Scene.
DAWN.creationArtHint: Choose artwork and the future token image in the sheet Overview.
DAWN.attributeArrayHint: Assign 4, 3, 2 and 2, one value to each Attribute.
DAWN.rankBudgetHint: Spend 8 Character Ranks, at least 4 on Skills. Each Skill has Rank 1–3. A value of 0 removes the Skill from the sheet.
DAWN.abilityBuilderHint: An Ability is optional. Choose a Verb, Noun and Condition. Buying it costs their sum (minimum 1); each Rank above the first costs 1 more. Refine the wording or use custom words with the Narrator on the sheet.
DAWN.creationBoonsHint: Choose a Primary Outlook and two of its Boons. Its required Inherent Boon is added free on completion. Changing Outlook archives the previous Boons while preserving their records.
DAWN.creationTechniquesHint: Learn 5 Technique levels in total from at most three Archetypes. Buttons 1–3 select the learned level of a whole Technique.
DAWN.creationFinishHint: Completion initializes starting Health and locks major sheet changes. All selected features are already saved.
DAWN.creationProgressHint: Build your character step by step or edit this same sheet freely.
DAWN.abilityMarksHint: ✢ allows no Condition. ✧ reduces the Noun cost by 1 when its category is narrowed to one specific thing. ☾ requires another Noun for X; a Verb cost of X equals that Noun’s cost.
DAWN.freeConditionHint: For ✢ choose either no Condition or a free Condition. For a free Condition select a listed one or enter your own, not both.
DAWN.abilityConditionConflict: Choose one Condition: listed or custom, or no Condition.
DAWN.specializeNoun: One specific thing from a ✧ category
DAWN.tierUpHint: Agree advancement with the Narrator (normally at 15 Experience or the party’s pace). Choose two different Attributes to gain +1 each. You gain 2 Ranks, 1 Boon and 2 Technique levels, which may be saved for Awakening. Current resources and recorded Experience are preserved.
DAWN.customSkillsHint: With the Narrator’s agreement: a mundane skill with clear limits; the book recommends a name of 2–5 words.
DAWN.invalidCustomSkill: Enter a name, Attribute and Rank from 1 to 3.
DAWN.restoreRequiredBoon: Restore the required Boon from removed entries to finish creation.
DAWN.effectChooseTargets: First target tokens on the scene.
DAWN.effectWriteUncertain: Effect write could not be confirmed and may have succeeded. Check the target’s effects before retrying; do not repeat blindly.
DAWN.effectTemplateMissing: The effect template was not found in its compendium.
DAWN.effectAppliedManual: Effect recorded. Some statistics are recalculated automatically; duration and other consequences are manual.
DAWN.effectManualHint: Target tokens on the scene. Some statistics are recalculated automatically; duration and other consequences are manual.
DAWN.requiredBoonMissing: The required Boon is missing from the catalog; creation was not completed.
DAWN.assassinManualPlacement: The Assassin is Disappeared: move the same token to the discard area manually. Until then it is not on the board.
DAWN.cannoneerManualClock: Create a four-segment Preparation clock for the Cannoneer manually.

DAWN.libraryUnavailable: This entry is unavailable or its library was closed.
DAWN.libraryPartial: Some compendiums could not be opened; results are incomplete:
DAWN.effectDisappearedManual: Return the Disappeared token to a legal space and remove the effect manually.
DAWN.returnDisappearedHint: Move this token to a legal space that is not adjacent to a character. Confirm when positioned to end the Disappeared state.
DAWN.returnDisappearedActorHint: This sheet is not attached to a specific token. Confirm that the return is allowed before removing the effect.
DAWN.effectReturnFailed: Could not finish the return. Check the token and effect before retrying.
DAWN.effectPartial: The effect was not applied to all targets. Check their states before retrying:
DAWN.speedEffectConflict: Hastened and Slowed are both active. Base Speed is shown; decide the result and order at the table.
DAWN.rollPublishUncertain: Could not confirm publication of the roll.
DAWN.rollRecoveryHint: Publication may have succeeded. Check the chat; no new dice are rolled while this result is pending.
DAWN.rollRecoveryMemoryOnly: The result remains only in this tab’s memory. Record it before reloading or closing the tab.
DAWN.rollNotFound: A message with this ID is not currently visible. Resolve the publication status at the table.

DAWN.rollRecoveryBlind: Blind roll: the result is visible only to the Narrator.

DAWN.rollInProgress: This character’s roll is still in progress in another window.
DAWN.rollRecoveryChanged: The roll state changed. Review the updated result before continuing.
DAWN.invalidTechniqueDefinition: Enter a name, an Archetype, a positive complexity and valid level fields.
DAWN.invalidArchetype: Choose one of the six Archetypes.
DAWN.unsavedTechniqueWarning: Close the editor and discard unsaved Technique changes?

If the start failed, check the combat context as well. Confirmation only clears the block; it does not retry or undo changes. Also check active effects.
